name: Hop-math arms: operand repair (§3), hop 3 location (§5), substrate-bind negative control (§6)
sealed: 2026-11-14, before any arm below is run; captures, sweeps and score files of entry 10 are inputs (already measured)
program: fp32 CPU replica of the answer row alone from the Job C captures (K/V fixed except the edited cells), the program the scale study's forecasts used (replica / native 0.98-1.04, entry 10). Negative control: the scale pipeline (Job C, A1, A2 split, score) on GPU

models.negative_control: Qwen2.5-0.5B with substrate-bind-0.5b-lora merged (W += scale * B @ A in fp32, saved bf16)

sealed_predictions_verbatim.s3_3: Prediction (derived from the closure numbers): on the readable-error stratum the repair rate equals that model's donor-moves rate on correct items within ±0.15 (0.6B 17/48, 1.5B 15/48, 1.7B 30/48, 3B 15/48, 4B 15/48), because downstream is intact (same-country mean keeps the answer on ≥ 39/42 from 1.5B up) and a single cell is sufficient at exactly that rate; on the right-operand stratum the repair rate is ≤ 0.1, because the cell is already right. If the readable stratum repairs at the donor-moves rate, the deep-chain failure is a wrong operand and nothing else; if it repairs at ≤ 0.1 too, the wrong operand is also read from other cells of the row, and the second arm (the same mean written into every carrier-KV cell of the row over [L_c-3, L_c+1]) must recover the band rate of about 0.6.
sealed_predictions_verbatim.s5_3: Hop 3 is mostly lexical with a smaller lookup in the same L21–L24 band: arm 1 moves the language at ≥ 0.7 of the capital rate; the language ladder's direct share is 0.60–0.75 against 0.45 for the capital on 1.7B, and its MLP share 0.25–0.40 with the same per-layer sign pattern (push at L21–L24, push back at L26–L27) at about half the amplitude; arm 2 shows no layer with a 2× asymmetry in favour of language; arm 3 recovers ≥ 0.8 of the language margin and 0.5–0.7 of the capital margin; arm 4's complement write names the language on about the full-subspace count (30/56 on 1.7B) and moves the native margin by under 20%. Falsifier: a language direct share below the capital's, or a band with a 2× language asymmetry, means hop 3 is a lookup at a location, and the "three hops" count is honest.
sealed_predictions_verbatim.s6_3: Prediction: d3 and d4 within ±1/14 of 18/28 and 3/14, carrier L21 KV0 unchanged, hop-2 split unchanged.

operational.items_s3: wrong items of d3-lm, d3-per, d4-work (main panel) and d5 (supplement; d5-short excluded); stratum readable = carrier country rank > 3 or unranked at (L_c, kv_c, row_at_item) from score-*.json / supscore-*.json; right-operand = rank <= 3
operational.mean_cell: same-true-country mean of the captured V at (L_c, kv_c, row_at_item(j)) over CORRECT main-panel items j of that country (any block); items with no such j are excluded and counted
operational.arm_cell: that mean written into (L_c, kv_c, row_at_item); repaired = full-vocabulary argmax == answer
operational.arm_band: per layer l in [L_c-3, L_c+1], the same-country mean of V at (l, kv_c, row_at_item(j)) written into (l, kv_c, row_at_item) together
operational.donor_moves_reference: entry 10 closure, native: 0.6B 17/48, 1.7B 30/48, 4B 15/48; recomputed in the replica on the same footing and printed beside
operational.s5_items: depth items d2, d3-lm, d3-per, d4-work (language answer) and base items (capital answer); arm 1 and arm 2 on correct items; arms 3 and 4 margin ratios on correct items, arm 4 language count over all 56 depth items
operational.s5_arm1: donor-country mean cell (mean over correct main-panel items of the panel donor's country, any block) at (L_c, kv_c, row_at_item); move = argmax == donor's answer; ladder at doses 0.5 and 1.0 (v + alpha (mean_d - v)) on M = logit(a) - logit(b), b = donor answer: direct = c . Delta o_{L_c}, MLP = sum_l c . Delta m_l, re-read = sum_{l>L_c} c . Delta o_l, norm = (rho1 - rho0)/rho0 c . h1, c = rho0 gamma_F * (W_U[a] - W_U[b]); shares over the replica's native delta; per-layer MLP terms reported
operational.s5_arm2: for each l in [L_c, L): answer-row MLP write alone, then attention write alone, replaced by the mean of the same captured port over the other correct items of the same block; normalised drop = (M0 - M)/M0 with M = logit(answer) - max over the rest of its set (languages or cities); a 2x asymmetry = median language drop >= 2 x median capital drop at a layer where the language drop >= 0.1
operational.s5_arm3: v replaced by its orthogonal projection onto W_g^T u_c (u_c = gamma_F * W_U[country]); ratio M_arm / M0 (median)
operational.s5_arm4: U = orthonormal basis of the 57 country directions; v_comp = orthogonal projection of v onto null(U^T W_g) (so W_g v_comp has no component in the country span), v_ctry = v - v_comp; each written alone; language named = argmax over the language set == answer; margin move |M - M0| / |M0| (median)
operational.s6: merged model through capture.py, sweep.py, arms.py split, score.py (no forecasts); compare accuracy d3 pooled and d4, model carrier, MLP share at dose 1.0 with entry 10's base Qwen2.5-0.5B (18/28, 3/14, L21 KV0, 0.10)
